title: Caracas Cathedral
geometryBasis: The named five-point cathedral footprint gives the west Plaza Bolívar frontage, long north aisle, and perimeter adjoining the separate Museo Sacro on the south.
sectionBasis: The original Lessmann view supports the stepped pale masonry facade, bell tower and clay roof hierarchy. The modern inventory supplies five naves, ten north-wall windows and later clock and remodeling details.
limitations: Section and tower heights, nave roof arrangements, window design, current ornament and vertical registration are approximate. The standing exterior combines exact archival imagery with the modern written inventory.
The model covers the cathedral’s envelope, attached sacristy and chapels. The separately mapped Museo Sacro, surrounding plazas, freestanding statues and the interior are separate scopes.
